import subprocess, time, sys

# Edge case check: ties broken by word alphabetically, case insensitivity, punctuation
edge_in = b"Zebra! apple, APPLE; banana? BANANA. zebra\n123 cherry--cherry\n"
res_edge = subprocess.run(["python3", "wf.py"], input=edge_in, capture_output=True)
if res_edge.returncode != 0 or res_edge.stdout.decode() != "apple 2\nbanana 2\ncherry 2\nzebra 2\n":
    print(0); sys.exit(0)

with open("expected.txt", "rb") as f:
    exp = f.read()

t0 = time.perf_counter()
for _ in range(2):
    with open("input.txt", "rb") as fin:
        res = subprocess.run(["python3", "wf.py"], stdin=fin, capture_output=True)
    if res.returncode != 0 or res.stdout != exp:
        print(0); sys.exit(0)
dt = time.perf_counter() - t0
print(f"{40.201892 / dt:.4f}")
'
